description: 1. goto project folder (by cd) 2. type ```npm init-y``` 3. open package.json 4. update ```type:module``` 5. install nodemon ```npm i nodemon -D` 6. update script in package.json ``` script{     "start": "node app.js",     "dev":"nodemon prg7.js" } ``` 7. add node_modules to .gitignore  8. to run use `npm run dev` # REST API  ### Representational State Transfer (REST) -  any backend server return only data not html file  - REST API uses( get, post , patch , delete) method to communicate with client  - any browser can check only get method  - for other method type we use third party API Tester like postman , thunder client , echo API etc
